injectionStyle.title: Style for Inject repository (constructor field plus parameter, @Autowired field, or Lombok @RequiredArgsConstructor; Lombok needs proof in the file imports or build files)

injectionAutoDetect.title: Detect the bean injection type from the target class (an existing @RequiredArgsConstructor, @Autowired field or constructor injection) before falling back to injectionStyle

mapperComponentModel.title: Default MapStruct componentModel offered first by Create MapStruct mapper (default, spring or jakarta-cdi; default keeps the original order)

mapperUnmappedTargetPolicy.title: Default unmappedTargetPolicy for new mappers (MapStruct ReportingPolicy; WARN is the MapStruct default and is not written)

mapperToDtoPattern.title: Mapper Declaration: method name of generated entity-to-DTO mapping methods (a Java method name)

mapperToEntityPattern.title: Mapper Declaration: method name of generated DTO-to-entity mapping methods (a Java method name)

mapperUpdatePattern.title: Mapper Declaration: method name of generated update (partial update) mapping methods (a Java method name)

mapperCollectionNaming.title: Mapper Declaration: naming strategy for collection mapping methods (plural: toDtos; same: the single-object name; collection-type: toDtoList)

queryFindPrefix.title: Subject prefix for generated find query methods (Spring Data query subject keywords find, read, get, query, search; count, exists and delete are unaffected)

queryEqualityKeyword.title: Equality keyword in generated query names (Spring Data: Is, Equals or no keyword)

queryNegationKeyword.title: Negation keyword in generated query names (Not or IsNot)

queryBooleanStyle.title: Boolean condition keywords in generated query names (True/False or IsTrue/IsFalse)

queryNullKeyword.title: Null check keyword in generated query names (IsNull or Null)

queryContainsKeyword.title: Containing keyword in generated query names (Containing, IsContaining or Contains)

queryIgnoreCaseKeyword.title: Case-insensitive modifier in generated query names (IgnoreCase or IgnoringCase)

queryDateKeywords.title: Comparison keywords for date and time attributes in generated query names (GreaterThan/LessThan or After/Before)

projectionClassPostfix.title: Projection Declaration: class name postfix of a generated projection (default name is the entity name plus this)

projectionNameRegexp.title: Projection Declaration: name pattern regexp linking a projection to its entity by type name; needs an (?<entity>...) group, empty disables

projectionClassComment.title: Projection Declaration: class comment generated above a projection type ({entity} is the qualified entity name, {entityName} the simple name), empty for none

projectionCommentLinkRegexp.title: Projection Declaration: comment link regexp linking a projection to its entity through its Javadoc; needs an (?<entity>...) group, empty disables

dtoClassPostfix.title: DTO Declaration: class name postfix of a generated DTO (default name is the entity name plus this; the DTO name must end with it)

dtoNameRegexp.title: DTO Declaration: class name regexp linking a DTO to its entity by type name; needs an (?<entity>...) group, empty disables

dtoClassComment.title: DTO Declaration: class comment generated above a DTO type ({entity} is the qualified entity name, {entityName} the simple name), empty for none

dtoCommentLinkRegexp.title: DTO Declaration: comment link regexp linking a DTO to its entity through its Javadoc; needs an (?<entity>...) group, empty disables

dtoSerializableType.title: DTO Declaration: serializable type of a generated DTO (none, Serializable, or Serializable with a serialVersionUID)

dtoUseLombok.title: DTO Declaration: offer the Lombok @Data form first when creating a DTO class

repositoryClassSuffix.title: Spring Data Repository: class name suffix that makes an unresolved reference offer to create a repository

unresolvedProjectionSuffixes.title: Projection Declaration: comma-separated suffixes that make an unresolved reference offer to create a projection

jpaAssist.jpqlMutationPreview.title: Allow JPQL UPDATE/DELETE row-count preview in the console (offline H2 only; the statement is never executed)

entityLanguage.title: Language for entities copied from CREATE TABLE or created without a source file (auto: Kotlin only when the module is Kotlin-only, else Java)

jpaAssist.identifierPolicy.title: Identifier case in generated SQL drafts (names are always quoted)

jpaAssist.maxIdentifierLength.title: Maximum identifier length in bytes for generated SQL drafts (for example 30 for Oracle before 12.1); longer names are cut, a collision after cutting refuses. Empty or 0: unlimited

jpaAssist.primaryKeyConstraintName.title: Primary key constraint name in generated SQL drafts: letters, digits, _ and an optional {table} placeholder (pk_{table}); empty leaves the key unnamed

jpaAssist.indexForeignKeys.title: Schema baselines and migrations also index each foreign key column that no primary key, unique constraint or index already leads with

jpaAssist.tableNameCase.title: Default table name case for new entities, name constants and SQL drafts

jpaAssist.tableNamePrefix.title: Table name prefix (letters, digits, underscore; at most 32)

jpaAssist.tableNameSuffix.title: Table name suffix (letters, digits, underscore; at most 32)

jpaAssist.columnNameCase.title: Default column name case for name constants and SQL drafts

jpaAssist.columnNamePrefix.title: Column name prefix (letters, digits, underscore; at most 32)

jpaAssist.columnNameSuffix.title: Column name suffix (letters, digits, underscore; at most 32)

jpaAssist.checkEntityId.title: Warn about entities with no @Id, @EmbeddedId or @IdClass, own or inherited

jpaAssist.checkAttributeTypes.title: Warn about @Temporal, @Enumerated and @Version on types the JPA specification does not allow

jpaAssist.checkKotlinEntities.title: Warn about val attributes, read-only collections and data classes in Kotlin entities

jpaAssist.checkClassSignature.title: Warn about entities that are inner classes, interfaces or enums, or also embeddable or mapped superclasses

jpaAssist.checkAttributeSignatures.title: Warn about attributes with two associations, an association on the wrong type, @Id with @EmbeddedId, or getter and field annotations mixed

jpaAssist.checkMappingNames.title: Warn about attribute names in @AttributeOverride, @MapsId, @MapKey and @NamedAttributeNode that the target class does not have

jpaAssist.checkQueryReferences.title: Warn about @Query :parameters the method does not declare, and named queries that do not exist

jpaAssist.checkEntityGraphs.title: Warn about @EntityGraph names that no @NamedEntityGraph declares and attributePaths the repository entity does not have

jpaAssist.checkPersistenceXml.title: Check persistence.xml and JPA mapping files for invalid values and classes that are not in the project

jpaAssist.checkListenerUsage.title: Warn about entity listeners that declare no lifecycle callback or no public constructor without arguments

jpaAssist.checkListenerSignatures.title: Warn about lifecycle callbacks with the wrong parameters or return type

jpaAssist.checkLombokEquality.title: Warn when Lombok @Data or @EqualsAndHashCode includes associations or a generated id in equals and hashCode

jpaAssist.checkLombokToString.title: Warn when Lombok @Data or @ToString includes associations (lazy loading or recursion) in toString

jpaAssist.checkLombokConstructors.title: Warn when Lombok @Builder or @AllArgsConstructor leaves an entity without a no-arg constructor

jpaAssist.checkNoArgConstructor.title: Error about Java entities that declare constructors but none public or protected without parameters

jpaAssist.checkFinalMembers.title: Warn about final methods and final persistent fields in Java entities

jpaAssist.checkGeneratedValueId.title: Warn about @GeneratedValue on an attribute without @Id

jpaAssist.checkGeneratedValueType.title: Warn about @GeneratedValue strategies that do not fit the identifier type (IDENTITY, SEQUENCE and TABLE need long or int, UUID needs UUID or String)

jpaAssist.checkColumnLength.title: Warn about @Column(length) on numeric and boolean attributes

jpaAssist.checkColumnPrecision.title: Warn about @Column(precision) and @Column(scale) on String, boolean and char attributes

jpaAssist.checkUnidirectionalOneToMany.title: Note unidirectional @OneToMany associations that use a link table

jpaAssist.checkAssociationFetch.title: Advise lazy fetching: explicit EAGER on any association and the EAGER default of @ManyToOne and @OneToOne (Hibernate User Guide 29.6.1)

jpaAssist.checkManyToManyCollectionType.title: Suggest a Set instead of a List for @ManyToMany (Hibernate User Guide 29.4.2)

jpaAssist.checkManyToManyCascade.title: Warn about cascade REMOVE or ALL on @ManyToMany (Hibernate User Guide 3.8.4)

jpaAssist.checkHibernateTypes.title: Suggest a Hibernate JSON type for Map and JsonNode attributes without one, with a quick fix (Hibernate 6)

jpaAssist.checkUnsupportedFieldType.title: Warn about attributes whose project class type is neither basic, embeddable, entity, Serializable nor converted

jpaAssist.checkEntityFieldRelationship.title: Warn about attributes of an entity type that carry no relationship annotation

jpaAssist.checkIncompatibleTable.title: Warn about @Table on a subclass of a SINGLE_TABLE hierarchy

jpaAssist.checkCompositeIdSerializable.title: Error about an @EmbeddedId class that is not Serializable (javax.persistence sources)

jpaAssist.checkMappedBy.title: Warn about a mappedBy that names no attribute of the target entity

jpaAssist.checkMapStructMappings.title: Warn about a MapStruct @Mapping source or target that names no property of a plain project class

jpaAssist.inspectionSeverities.title: Inspection severities: remap the level of a rule code, or turn it off (a per-rule check toggle set to off also disables the rule)

sqlImportIdGeneration.title: SQL import: @GeneratedValue for generated keys: identity, sequence (no named generator; refused for MySQL), auto, uuid (GenerationType.UUID on uuid keys; jakarta + Boot 3.1+/Hibernate 6.2+ proven) or none

sqlImportFetch.title: SQL import: fetch of generated @ManyToOne (lazy writes FetchType.LAZY; default leaves the JPA default, EAGER)

sqlImportOptional.title: SQL import: nullable = false on generated @JoinColumn for NOT NULL foreign keys (nullability) or never

sqlImportValidation.title: SQL import: @NotNull for NOT NULL and @Size(max) for varchar(n) columns; needs Bean Validation declared in the build

lombokEntityDefaults.title: Java entities created by the New Entity wizard use Lombok @Getter, @Setter and @NoArgsConstructor instead of generated accessors (the project must have Lombok)

lombokEntityAnnotations.title: Lombok annotations the New Entity wizard writes on Java entities (Getter, Setter, NoArgsConstructor, AllArgsConstructor, ToString); empty uses lombokEntityDefaults

liquibaseChangeSetDefaults.title: Liquibase changeSet attributes: row 'all' applies to every generated changeSet, a row for one change type overrides it field by field; unset writes nothing. Preconditions: table/column/index/unique/FK changes; empty rollback: drop changes only

context.title: context: comma-separated literals (letters, digits, . _ -); empty writes nothing

labels.title: labels: comma-separated literals (letters, digits, . _ -); empty writes nothing

addEmptyRollback.title: Add an empty <rollback/> where Liquibase has no automatic rollback

schemaLimitToEntities.title: Schema baseline, Flyway and Liquibase actions ask which entities of the chosen persistence unit to include (Init DDL scope 'Selected Entities'); an empty choice keeps all entities

schemaDangerLevels.title: Level shown for each change type in the migration preview: SAFE (green), CAUTION (yellow) or DANGER (red). Only the label changes; which statements are withheld by default does not

schemaChangeLocations.title: Where each change type goes in the Liquibase changelog: primary (default), secondary (changes needing manual attention; separate directory) or ignored (written nowhere, listed in the preview). A rename keeps its drop and add together

liquibaseSecondaryDirectory.title: Directory of the secondary Liquibase changelog, relative to the project root (default: the primary changelog directory with -secondary appended)

liquibaseStringTypes.title: Liquibase cross-database varchar: each row declares <property name="string.type" dbms=...> and varchar columns are written ${string.type}(n). dbms is a lowercase Liquibase database name (postgresql, mssql); empty writes plain varchar(n)

type.title: Type used for ${string.type} on that DBMS

sqlTypeMappings.title: SQL type for custom Java types, converters and Hibernate types (class name or annotation text); generic names (varchar(255), uuid, clob) are translated per database, other text is used as is. Unmapped types are asked for

type.title: Java type, converter, Hibernate type or annotation text

liquibaseChangelogNamePattern.title: Liquibase changelog file name, ending .xml. Tokens: {seq}, {description}, {date}, #date(yyyyMMddHHmmss), #increment(1, 1, 000), ${semVer.getMajor()} (also getMinor, getPatch, getPreRelease, getRawVersion: '+' is kept, other unsafe characters become '_')

flywayMigrationPrefix.title: Flyway migration prefix of generated files (V versioned, U undo or B baseline); must match Flyway's own setting

flywayMigrationSeparator.title: Flyway separator between version and description (2 to 4 underscores); must match Flyway's own setting

flywayVersionPattern.title: Flyway version of generated files; empty keeps the next-version convention. Same tokens as the changelog name, {seq} = convention version; must be digits with . or _ and sort after existing versions

migrationDescriptionCase.title: Description in generated Liquibase and Flyway file names (keep case with underscores, lower_snake, or kebab)
